title: Dysregulated AKT signaling reprograms osteosarcoma to drive selective reliance on EP300.
snippet: Cancers depend on transcriptional control to maintain the malignant cell state. EP300 and CBP are paralogous master epigenetic enzymes that control normal and malignant transcription.
